title: Remove Duplicates from an Array
statement:
You are given an array of `n` integers that may contain repeated values. Remove the duplicates so that every distinct value appears exactly once. Keep the **first occurrence** of each value and preserve the relative order of the elements that remain.

Print the resulting array.
inputFormat:
The first line contains an integer `n`.
The second line contains `n` integers.
outputFormat: Print the array after removing duplicates as space-separated integers on one line.

examples.explanation: The values 4, 2 and 7 each appear twice; only their first occurrences are kept, and the order of first occurrences is 4, 2, 7, 9, 1.
All elements are equal, so a single 3 remains.
Negative values and zero are treated like any other value.

hints: Comparing every element with every earlier element works but is O(n^2). What do you need to know about each value as you scan?
Keep a hash set of values already seen.
Scan left to right and append an element to the answer only if it is not in the set yet, then add it to the set.
